findings.evidence: File does not exist; required by AGENTS.md §12 for plan verification
findings.expected: Existence of docs/plan_verification_status.json with plan status verification data
findings.impact: Cannot verify plan status against actual implementation; violates documented verification process

findings.evidence: ProjectService.create method has minimal JSDoc in Russian; only 2-line comment
findings.expected: Full JSDoc per docs/development/07-jsdoc-style-guide.md: purpose, invariants, side effects, failure semantics
findings.actual: Single-line English summary 'создаёт новый project' without Russian documentation
findings.impact: Public API lacks required Russian JSDoc per AGENTS.md §12

findings.evidence: Most route files (e.g. projects.ts, approvals.ts, epics.ts) export interfaces/functions without JSDoc
findings.expected: All exported public API functions and interfaces documented in Russian per jsdoc-style-guide.md
findings.actual: 106+ exported functions/classes; most lack JSDoc or have incomplete comments
findings.impact: Public API documentation incomplete; violates AGENTS.md §12 policy

findings.evidence: Governance plan references migration evidence files that have status=superseded
findings.expected: Active governance documents should reference current evidence, not superseded ones
findings.impact: Documentation chain points to outdated evidence; may cause confusion

findings.evidence: Plan contains explicit anti-scope-creep warnings ('не добавлять post-v1 scope без отдельного утверждённого плана')
findings.expected: Scope creep prevention policy should be consistently enforced and documented
findings.actual: Policy warnings exist but no evidence of enforcement mechanism or approval workflow
findings.impact: Risk of unapproved scope expansion despite documented warnings

findings.evidence: All plans show status:completed in YAML frontmatter, but migration map shows files renamed on 2026-09-23
findings.expected: Plan status should reflect actual implementation completion, not just documentation state
findings.actual: Plans marked completed despite recent renaming/migration activity
findings.impact: Status may not match actual code implementation state

findings.evidence: Evidence directory contains files with status=superseded but no active replacement
findings.expected: Superseded evidence should have active successor or explicit deprecation note
findings.actual: Files like 01-baseline.md, 02-progress-ledger.md marked superseded without clear active replacement
findings.impact: Documentation chain broken; unclear what evidence is authoritative

conclusion: Выявлены 3 IMPORTANT и 4 MINOR нарушения. Критическая проблема: отсутствует требуемый план plan_verification_status.json (BLOCKER). JSDoc на публичных API неполный. Статус планов может не соответствовать фактическому состоянию кода. Рекомендовано: 1) Создать plan_verification_status.json, 2) Дополнить JSDoc согласно стилю, 3) Привести статус планов в соответствие с реализацией.
